messages:
maya: Hi all :wave: I accepted the org invite but I can't see any private repos. Tried to re-run CI for my PR and it gives a 403.
sam: @maya can you paste the exact error you see? is that from the Actions UI or the CLI?
maya: From Actions UI. It shows: `403 Forbidden` and a small banner: 'You must enable SSO and 2FA to access organization resources.'
it-bot: reminder: Redwood Inference requires SSO + 2FA for org access. See https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso
maya: I thought I enabled 2FA on my personal acct earlier this week. Could that still block me?
jen: @maya did you accept the invite with your personal GitHub or your work email (maya@redwood.ai)?
maya: I accidentally accepted with my personal account (maya.personal@gmail.com). I already opened a PR from that account :grimacing:
sam: ok that's the common pitfall. Two quick routes:
- add your work email to the personal account and verify it, then admins can map the account to SSO; or
- claim the org invite with your work account so your work account becomes the org member (but PRs from personal account will be orphaned unless transferred).
maya: i'd like to avoid losing PR history if possible.
platform-eng: we can preserve the PR. Options:
1) map your personal github to the org by adding work email + verifying + enabling 2FA, then accept SSO. PR will remain under the same account.
2) if you create/join with your work account, we can use the 'transfer issue/PR' flow but it rewrites author attribution in the UI.

Steps for option 1 (recommended):
- go to Settings > Emails on github.com and add maya@redwood.ai
- verify the email from the confirmation mail
- enable TOTP 2FA (or register a security key)
- visit the org invite link and accept SSO

If you hit errors, ping me and I'll run a team sync and grant temporary repo write so you can re-run jobs.
maya: added the work email and verified it, enabled TOTP 2FA. When I go to the invite link it still shows 'Team membership pending'.
platform-eng: give me a sec, I'll force a mapping sync and push you into the eng & devex teams.
platform-eng: ran org member sync and invited maya@redwood.ai to teams: eng, devex. Also temporarily granted write to repo "infra" to allow CI rerun.
sam: nice. maya try reloading Actions and re-run the job.
maya: can re-run now and the job accepted the request :tada: I can see the private repos too.
jen: welcome officially! please drop a note in #new-hires-intros when you have a minute :smile:
maya: thanks everyone — saved my branch and PR, will coordinate with @sam to move it later if needed. Appreciate the quick help!
